text:
Seedance 2.0 Prompt:

Use @[char ref] as the authoritative character reference. Use @[storyboard ref] as the authoritative shot blueprint, camera guide, progression map, and flight choreography reference. Follow the storyboard panel order and visual escalation while preserving character identity exactly.

ENVIRONMENT: Grassy daylight field rising into dense clouds, then radiant sunlight above a vast cloud sea.
MOOD: Joyful, agile, weightless, controlled wonder.
STYLE: High-end animated fantasy film, stylized cinematic realism, premium cloud lighting, painterly atmosphere, vibrant cyan and turquoise wind magic.
LOGIC RULE: The shoes create lift through wind glyphs, airflow ribbons, spiral gusts, vortex streaks, and compressed air bursts under each sole.

SHOT 1: Extreme macro low side / boot heels in grass as cyan wind gathers and grass bends inward / SFX: soft rising gust.
SHOT 2: Tight low front insert / heels touch first, small glyphs appear beneath both shoes, grass flattens / SFX: clean magic click.
SHOT 3: Low close-up / toes slide together second, airflow wraps under soles, shoes pulse with compressed wind / SFX: pressure thrum.
SHOT 4: Worm’s-eye 24mm tilt-up / vertical wind burst lifts her from grass, clothing and hair snap upward / SFX: airy impact.
SHOT 5: Fast upward track / she shoots screen right and upward, field shrinking below, boot trails begin / SFX: acceleration rush.
SHOT 6: Wide pullback / she arcs toward cloud layers, hat and cloak readable, ribbons curve behind her / SFX: open sky swell.
SHOT 7: Side tracking / one boot plants on invisible compressed air, burst forms under sole, she rebounds forward / SFX: soft air pop.
SHOT 8: Match-move wide / she leaps through cloud vapor, mist parts around her, ribbon trails twist behind / SFX: cloud whoosh.
SHOT 9: Dynamic orbit / she spins and surfs a curved wind stream, boots carve a vortex line, cloak flares / SFX: graceful whirl.
SHOT 10: 50mm push-in / upper body and hands reach into wind currents, expression calm and joyful / SFX: warm airy hush.
SHOT 11: Behind-below chase / final wind step punches through thinning clouds, sunshafts break ahead / SFX: bright surge.
SHOT 12: Epic high wide / above the cloud sea, she glides screen right and upward with long luminous ribbon trails / SFX: release.
content:
Use @[char ref] as the authoritative character reference to preserve character identity exactly across all shots  
Use @[storyboard ref] as the authoritative shot blueprint to control camera guide, progression map, and flight choreography  
Follow the storyboard panel order and visual escalation to maintain coherent shot progression  
Define ENVIRONMENT, MOOD, STYLE, and a LOGIC RULE in the prompt to lock setting, tone, visual look, and consistent VFX/physics behavior  
Specify each shot with concrete camera framing/lens and movement (e.g., extreme macro low side, worm’s-eye 24mm tilt-up, 50mm push-in, fast upward track, dynamic orbit) to direct cinematography shot-by-shot  
Include per-shot VFX/action cues (e.g., wind glyphs, airflow ribbons, vortex streaks, compressed air bursts under each sole) to keep the “lift” mechanism consistent and readable  
Add per-shot SFX descriptors (e.g., soft rising gust, clean magic click, pressure thrum) to reinforce timing and intensity beats in the sequence

translations.es:
Usa @[char ref] como la referencia de personaje autorizada para preservar la identidad del personaje exactamente en todas las tomas  
Usa @[storyboard ref] como el plano de toma autorizado para controlar la guía de cámara, el mapa de progresión y la coreografía de vuelo  
Sigue el orden de los paneles del storyboard y la escalada visual para mantener una progresión coherente de las tomas  
Define ENVIRONMENT, MOOD, STYLE y una LOGIC RULE en el prompt para fijar el escenario, el tono, el aspecto visual y el comportamiento consistente de VFX/física  
Especifica cada toma con encuadre/lente de cámara concreto y movimiento (por ejemplo, macro extremo bajo lateral, vista de gusano 24mm inclinada hacia arriba, 50mm acercamiento, seguimiento rápido hacia arriba, órbita dinámica) para dirigir la cinematografía toma por toma  
Incluye indicaciones de VFX/acción por toma (por ejemplo, glifos de viento, cintas de flujo de aire, estelas de vórtice, ráfagas de aire comprimido bajo cada suela) para mantener el mecanismo de “elevación” consistente y legible  
Añade descriptores de SFX por toma (por ejemplo, suave ráfaga ascendente, clic mágico limpio, zumbido de presión) para reforzar los ritmos de tiempo e intensidad en la secuencia
translations.fr:
Utilisez @[char ref] comme référence de personnage autoritaire pour préserver l'identité du personnage exactement à travers tous les plans  
Utilisez @[storyboard ref] comme plan directeur autoritaire pour contrôler le guide de la caméra, la carte de progression et la chorégraphie de vol  
Suivez l'ordre des panneaux du storyboard et l'escalade visuelle pour maintenir une progression cohérente des plans  
Définissez ENVIRONMENT, MOOD, STYLE, et une LOGIC RULE dans le prompt pour verrouiller le décor, le ton, l'apparence visuelle et le comportement cohérent des VFX/physique  
Spécifiez chaque plan avec un cadrage/objectif et un mouvement de caméra concrets (par exemple, macro extrême bas côté, contre-plongée 24mm, zoom avant 50mm, suivi rapide vers le haut, orbite dynamique) pour diriger la cinématographie plan par plan  
Incluez des indices VFX/action par plan (par exemple, glyphes de vent, rubans de flux d'air, traînées de vortex, rafales d'air comprimé sous chaque semelle) pour maintenir le mécanisme de "levage" cohérent et lisible  
Ajoutez des descripteurs SFX par plan (par exemple, souffle montant doux, clic magique net, vrombissement de pression) pour renforcer le rythme et l'intensité dans la séquence
translations.ja:
---
@[char ref]を権威あるキャラクター参照として使用し、すべてのショットでキャラクターのアイデンティティを正確に保持する  
@[storyboard ref]を権威あるショットの設計図として使用し、カメラガイド、進行マップ、飛行振付を制御する  
ストーリーボードのパネル順序と視覚的なエスカレーションに従い、一貫したショットの進行を維持する  
プロンプトでENVIRONMENT、MOOD、STYLE、およびLOGIC RULEを定義し、設定、トーン、ビジュアルの外観、一貫したVFX/物理挙動を固定する  
各ショットを具体的なカメラフレーミング/レンズと動き（例：極端なマクロ低側、ワームズアイ24mmティルトアップ、50mmプッシュイン、速い上方トラック、ダイナミックオービット）で指定し、ショットごとの撮影を指示する  
各ショットにVFX/アクションのキュー（例：風のグリフ、気流のリボン、渦のストリーク、各ソールの下の圧縮空気バースト）を含め、「リフト」メカニズムを一貫して読みやすくする  
各ショットにSFXの説明（例：ソフトな上昇する突風、クリーンなマジッククリック、圧力のうなり）を追加し、シーケンスのタイミングと強度のビートを強化する  
---
translations.ko:
---
@[char ref]를 권위 있는 캐릭터 참조로 사용하여 모든 샷에서 캐릭터 정체성을 정확히 유지  
@[storyboard ref]를 권위 있는 샷 청사진으로 사용하여 카메라 가이드, 진행 지도, 비행 안무를 제어  
스토리보드 패널 순서와 시각적 고조를 따라 일관된 샷 진행을 유지  
환경, 분위기, 스타일, 논리 규칙을 프롬프트에 정의하여 설정, 톤, 시각적 외관, 일관된 VFX/물리적 행동을 고정  
각 샷을 구체적인 카메라 프레이밍/렌즈와 움직임(예: 극단적인 매크로 로우 사이드, 벌레의 눈 24mm 틸트 업, 50mm 푸시 인, 빠른 상향 트랙, 동적 궤도)으로 지정하여 샷별 촬영을 지시  
각 샷별 VFX/액션 큐(예: 바람 글리프, 기류 리본, 소용돌이 줄무늬, 각 발바닥 아래 압축 공기 폭발)를 포함하여 "리프트" 메커니즘을 일관되고 읽기 쉽게 유지  
각 샷별 SFX 설명자(예: 부드러운 상승 바람, 깨끗한 마법 클릭, 압력 진동)를 추가하여 시퀀스의 타이밍과 강도 비트를 강화  
---
translations.pt-BR:
Use @[char ref] como a referência de personagem autoritária para preservar a identidade do personagem exatamente em todas as cenas  
Use @[storyboard ref] como o plano de referência autoritário para controlar o guia de câmera, mapa de progressão e coreografia de voo  
Siga a ordem dos painéis do storyboard e a escalada visual para manter a progressão coerente das cenas  
Defina AMBIENTE, HUMOR, ESTILO e uma REGRA LÓGICA no prompt para fixar o cenário, tom, aparência visual e comportamento consistente de VFX/física  
Especifique cada cena com enquadramento/lente de câmera concreto e movimento (por exemplo, macro extremo lateral baixo, 24mm tilt-up de olho de verme, 50mm push-in, trilha rápida para cima, órbita dinâmica) para direcionar a cinematografia cena a cena  
Inclua dicas de VFX/ação por cena (por exemplo, glifos de vento, fitas de fluxo de ar, rastros de vórtice, rajadas de ar comprimido sob cada sola) para manter o mecanismo de “elevação” consistente e legível  
Adicione descritores de SFX por cena (por exemplo, rajada suave crescente, clique mágico limpo, zumbido de pressão) para reforçar o timing e a intensidade dos momentos na sequência
translations.zh-CN:
使用@[char ref]作为权威角色参考，以确保在所有镜头中准确保持角色身份  
使用@[storyboard ref]作为权威镜头蓝图，以控制摄像机指南、进程图和飞行编排  
遵循分镜板顺序和视觉升级，以保持连贯的镜头进展  
在prompt中定义ENVIRONMENT, MOOD, STYLE和LOGIC RULE，以锁定环境、基调、视觉外观和一致的VFX/物理行为  
用具体的摄像机构图/镜头和运动（例如，极端微距低侧，虫眼24mm仰拍，50mm推进，快速向上轨道，动态环绕）指定每个镜头，以逐镜头指导电影摄影  
包括每个镜头的VFX/动作提示（例如，风符号，气流丝带，漩涡条纹，每个鞋底下的压缩空气爆发）以保持“升力”机制的一致性和可读性  
添加每个镜头的SFX描述（例如，柔和上升的风，清脆的魔法点击，压力嗡鸣）以加强序列中的时机和强度节拍
